schema.description: A bounded, presentation-only surface update with stable component identifiers and declared Galaxy bindings.

Badge.description: Compact status label rendered by the Generous A2UI Badge adapter.

Card.description: Presentational container; content is supplied through child component references.

Charts.description: Read-only Generous chart using its current serializable data and options contract.

DataTable.description: Read-only Generous data table using serializable columns, rows, and display options.

Heading.description: A2UI heading alias rendered from text and a heading usage hint.

KnowledgeGraph.description: Bounded entity-relationship graph with no executable behavior or network sources.

Markdown.description: Markdown rendered in preview-only mode for promoted surfaces.

Stack.description: Alias of the vertical Column A2UI adapter.

StatsDisplay.description: Serializable read-only KPI display from Generous Tool UI.

Text.description: Bounded text rendered by the Generous A2UI typography adapter.

Timeline.description: Zoomable timeline of dated events: picture cards on an axis, stacked by importance, coloured by category, with per-card styling (card shape, colour, font), subtitles, tags for filtering, periods (end dates), shaded eras and an optional read-more link per event. Give events directly, or a spreadsheet-style table (columns, rows and a map from timeline fields to column names) that is converted into events. Plain text only. Dates state their precision. The legacy TimelineJS shape (data.events with start_date and text.headline) is still accepted for surfaces saved before this shape existed.

Title.description: A2UI title alias rendered from text and a heading usage hint.

SVGPreview.description: Static SVG drawing. Rendered by rebuilding an allowlisted subset of elements and attributes, never by injecting the source as markup.
